_about: R-26 test 26: the automatic `layer` check reads each seat's expected layer and header from `gate.py --resolve`. Each run is the named scenario's first good run on a seat; `layer` swaps the injected body (`layer_of`) or header (`header`); `omit_loader_log` drops the case hook log's loader line on those turns. Turn 2 of a two-turn scenario is the real 2.1.280 resumed turn (the loader's output in the stream, no hook attachment in the case transcript), attributed through the log.

runs.label: good: the fable seat gets the layer and header --resolve names, its resumed turn attributed by the log
good: the opus55 seat gets the layer and header --resolve names, its resumed turn attributed by the log
bad: the body of another layer file
bad: a header naming another model
bad: gate.sh's old `opus` row (the Opus 5 layer and header) on the seat `opus` resolves to
bad: the resumed turn's log line removed (its loader output unattributed)
